symptom.statement: Migration parity validator fails after a source-only restoration.

immediate_cause.statement: A live migration identity is not bound to the exact canonical source before apply.

systemic_root_cause.statement: Migration identity and source digest are not reserved atomically before live apply, allowing source/live divergence to recur.

causal_chain.statement: Live apply can occur before exact source identity is reserved.
The post-cutover parity validator detects the divergence after the live effect.

first_bad_control.statement: Pre-apply migration identity reservation does not enforce exact source identity before the effect.

escape_control.statement: The post-cutover migration parity validator detects divergence only after the live effect.

recurrence_evidence.fact: The same source/live divergence class occurred more than once.
The current parity validator observed the same divergence class.

unavailable_source_assessments.rationale: Historical caller attribution is incomplete, but the selected pre-apply boundary applies regardless of which historical caller produced the prior effect.

should_exist_assessment.subject: migration parity control
should_exist_assessment.elimination_impact: Live/source drift could pass without a deterministic currentness check.
should_exist_assessment.native_or_existing_alternative: Reuse the existing A2R parity boundary rather than create a second parity engine.

alternatives.description: Add a pre-apply identity reservation hard guard.

rejected_alternatives.reason: It does not prevent recurrence at the origin boundary.
It exceeds the minimum sufficient repair and increases blast radius.

falsification_results.verification_method: Execute the exact candidate repair against the bypass scenario before implementation closure.
falsification_results.expected_result: The repair blocks or safely handles the bypass scenario without duplicate or unauthorized effect.

falsification_results.verification_method: Execute the exact candidate repair against the retry scenario before implementation closure.
falsification_results.expected_result: The repair blocks or safely handles the retry scenario without duplicate or unauthorized effect.

falsification_results.expected_result: The repair blocks or safely handles the concurrency scenario without duplicate or unauthorized effect.

falsification_results.expected_result: The repair blocks or safely handles the partial_failure scenario without duplicate or unauthorized effect.

falsification_results.verification_method: Execute the exact candidate repair against the stale_state scenario before implementation closure.
falsification_results.expected_result: The repair blocks or safely handles the stale_state scenario without duplicate or unauthorized effect.

falsification_results.verification_method: Execute the exact candidate repair against the interrupted_execution scenario before implementation closure.
falsification_results.expected_result: The repair blocks or safely handles the interrupted_execution scenario without duplicate or unauthorized effect.

falsification_results.verification_method: Execute the exact candidate repair against the replay_or_duplicate scenario before implementation closure.
falsification_results.expected_result: The repair blocks or safely handles the replay_or_duplicate scenario without duplicate or unauthorized effect.

falsification_results.verification_method: Execute the exact candidate repair against the undeclared_or_unversioned_caller scenario before implementation closure.
falsification_results.expected_result: The repair blocks or safely handles the undeclared_or_unversioned_caller scenario without duplicate or unauthorized effect.

invariant.statement: A live migration may apply only after exact source identity and digest are reserved and current.

hard_guard.fail_closed_condition: Block when exact source identity or digest is missing or mismatched.
hard_guard.observable_result: No live migration effect occurs and a deterministic blocking code is emitted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Historical source/live divergence cases are rejected before effect.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Replay the historical divergence fixtures through the pre-apply gate.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Current parity remains clean after a valid apply.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Run the canonical migration source parity validator on the exact candidate head.
Execute the same governed request twice with the same idempotency identity.
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: No second effective apply identity is minted.

historical_regressions.observed_failure: Live/source identity diverged before the parity gate detected it.

planned_regressions.scenario: Attempt apply without a reserved exact source identity.
planned_regressions.verification_method: Invoke the pre-apply boundary without the reservation receipt.

planned_regressions.scenario: Retry an already reserved migration request.
planned_regressions.expected_result: Reuse the same effective identity without duplicate apply.

planned_regressions.scenario: Use a stale source digest after reservation.
planned_regressions.verification_method: Mutate the source head between reservation and apply.

current_uncertainties.uncertainty: The exact historical agent or connector identity for one prior migration effect is no longer recoverable.
evidence_needed: historical caller identity linked to the prior effect
current_uncertainties.design_consequence: No repair-design change: the selected boundary is caller-independent and contains any caller that reaches the apply path.

residual_risks.risk: Legacy migrations may require grandfathered classification outside the repaired boundary.

next_gate.entry_condition: The systemic repair spec remains evidence-bound and no DESIGN_BLOCKING uncertainty appears.
next_gate.exit_condition: The owning implementation operation applies the bounded stages and converts planned falsifications into observed verification before closure.

implementation_delta.action: Require exact source identity and digest reservation before any live migration effect.
implementation_delta.rationale: Moves parity protection from post-effect detection to the first preventable boundary.

implementation_delta.action: Connect callers to the existing reservation boundary before enforcement is activated for that caller set.
implementation_delta.rationale: Preserves compatibility while moving consumers onto the common guard.

transition_plan.strategy: Adopt the common reservation boundary before enabling fail-closed enforcement for each bounded consumer set.
transition_plan.compatibility_rule: Consumers not yet proven ready keep baseline behavior until their explicit adoption stage; no blanket switch is permitted.

stages.entry_condition: Exact consumer set and current source binding are known.
changes: Connect the bounded consumer set to the existing source-identity reservation boundary.
stages.exit_condition: Consumer set demonstrates the reservation path without changing unrelated consumers.
stages.rollback_scope: Restore only the bounded consumer-set binding.

stages.entry_condition: The bounded consumer set passed adoption readback.
changes: Enable fail-closed pre-apply enforcement for the bounded consumer set.
stages.exit_condition: Valid applies succeed and stale/missing identity attempts block deterministically.
stages.rollback_scope: Disable enforcement only for the bounded consumer set while preserving evidence.

trigger_conditions: Valid governed applies are blocked or unrelated consumers change behavior.
inverse_actions: Restore the prior consumer binding and pre-apply enforcement definition for the bounded stage.
protected_history: Do not rewrite historical migration executions, parity failures or effect receipts.
verification: Re-read exact function/contract identity and rerun parity/readback after rollback.
